content: Screening for presymptomatic type 1 diabetes involves the detection of islet autoantibodies. These autoantibodies include those targeting insulin, glutamic acid decarboxylase (GAD), islet antigen-2 (IA-2), and zinc transporter 8 (ZnT8). The identification of multiple autoantibodies in an individual is indicative of a significantly elevated risk for the future onset of type 1 diabetes.
